author: Mark Atwood
text: Rust idiom confidence: 80% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: (a) JMAP-ly0n.21's claim that retyping ChatPushConfig.kinds to Option<Vec<ChatKind>> is wire-compatible relies on ChatKind::Other(String) preserving unknown wire values — the impl_string_enum! macro idiom does this elsewhere in the workspace but I did not crack open jmap-types::impl_string_enum to confirm the Other(String) round-trip preserves the exact bytes (vs. e.g. lowercasing them). A 5-line probe deserialising '"MixedCaseChannel"' as ChatKind, re-serialising, and asserting byte-equality would settle it. (b) JMAP-ly0n.20's recommendation to depend on jmap-cid-types from jmap-chat-types adds a path dep that the per-crate AGENTS.md does not currently permit ('Dependencies: jmap-types, serde, serde_json only'). The fix requires either an AGENTS.md amendment or an alternative that keeps the dep set minimal (e.g. inline a private newtype). I did not propose the AGENTS.md path because it is a workspace policy call. (c) The Display/Serialize delegation refactor in JMAP-ly0n.24 assumes serializer.collect_str() does not allocate a tmp String on every call — it does internally (via fmt::Write into a String), so on a hot path the rewrite is a small allocation regression vs. the current serialize_str on a borrowed &str. SenderId is not on any known hot path so this is theoretical, but worth verifying before applying the refactor blindly. Uncertainty driven by: read-only review forbids running probes, and the canonical-template sibling jmap-mail-types was not cross-referenced for any of these specific idioms (e.g. does jmap-mail-types use Vec<MailboxRole> in any *PushConfig analog, or Vec<String>? — the canonical answer would harden JMAP-ly0n.21). Would raise confidence if: (1) the ChatKind round-trip byte-equality probe is added in a downstream /do-beads session, (2) a workspace grep confirms whether any other *Push* struct in the family uses typed-enum Vec or stringly-typed Vec — whichever is canonical settles JMAP-ly0n.21 either direction, (3) the AGENTS.md dep-policy question on JMAP-ly0n.20 is resolved one way or the other before that bead is worked.
